summary: AgentCore run loop is implemented as agent_core::run_loop. It accepts intents, freezes plans, persists every RunState transition through RunStore, delegates policy and effect preparation through the Security Execution Foundation, pauses high-risk steps before effect preparation, supports approval/denial/suspension/recovery operations, and exposes compact run projections for CLI/TUI surfaces.

acceptance.criterion: AgentCore can accept an intent and produce a persisted Planned state.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_loop::tests::accept_and_plan_run_persists_planned_state verifies Accepted -> Planning -> Planned transitions, frozen plan binding, and reopened FileRunStore visibility.

acceptance.criterion: Read-only steps can advance automatically through verification and sealing.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_loop::tests::read_only_step_advances_through_verification_and_sealing verifies PolicyEvaluated, EffectPrepared, EffectObserved, CommitSealed, observation ref persistence, and Completed terminal state.

acceptance.criterion: Execute-with-confirmation steps pause and do not prepare effects before approval.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_loop::tests::approval_required_step_pauses_without_preparing_effect confirms restart-service enters AwaitingApproval and no restart EffectPrepared audit event exists.

acceptance.criterion: Denied or timed-out approvals move to Denied or Suspended without execution.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_loop::tests::denied_and_timed_out_approvals_do_not_prepare_protected_effect covers Denied and Suspended/Expired approval states with no protected effect preparation.

acceptance.criterion: Crash-safe state updates are visible through RunStore.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_loop::tests::recover_run_uses_persisted_state_projection reloads FileRunStore after recovery marker attachment and confirms AwaitingApproval plus ResumeFromStep.
agent_core::run_loop::tests::compact_projection_is_cli_and_tui_ready checks RunProjection JSON and to_cli_line output. main.rs was not modified because it already has unrelated uncommitted changes.

safety_ordering: RunStore state transition is persisted before effect preparation
AwaitingApproval path records policy and approval state without EffectPrepared
Allowed path prepares, observes, verifies, and seals through EffectEnvelope
Recovery uses persisted PlanRun plus AuditJournal timeline
